theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (u : Euclid P) (r₀ ρ : ℝ), IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 1 2 M → ‖u‖ = 1 → 0 < r₀ → r₀ • u ∈ M → 0 < ρ → (∀ x ∈ M ∩ ball (r₀ • u) ρ, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → t • x ∈ ball (r₀ • u) ρ → t • x ∈ M) → ∃ (e : Euclid P) (s : ℝ) (N : Set (Euclid P)) (γ : ℝ → Euclid P), ‖e‖ = 1 ∧ inner ℝ u e = 0 ∧ 0 < s ∧ s < r₀ ∧ IsOpen N ∧ r₀ • u ∈ N ∧ N ⊆ ball (r₀ • u) ρ ∧ (∀ x ∈ N, 0 < inner ℝ x u) ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 γ (Ioo (-s) s) ∧ γ 0 = u ∧ deriv γ 0 = e ∧ (∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, ‖γ α‖ = 1 ∧ 0 < inner ℝ (γ α) u ∧ Real.arctan (inner ℝ (γ α) e / inner ℝ (γ α) u) = α) ∧ M ∩ N = (fun q : ℝ × ℝ => q.1 • γ q.2) '' (Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s) ×ˢ Ioo (-s) s) ∧ ∀ t ∈ Ioo (r₀ - s) (r₀ + s), ∀ α ∈ Ioo (-s) s, Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M (t • γ α)) = Submodule.span ℝ {γ α, deriv γ α}
